name: pr-queue
description: Run a pull-request (or issue) queue for an area of alchemy — search GitHub for open PRs/issues matching a criteria (e.g. "cloudflare", "docker", "aws/rds", an author, a label), shortlist the top 10 ordered by ease of fixing, then launch each one as its own detached top-level T3 thread (`t3_thread_launch`, `workspaceStrategy: "worktree"`): each thread checks out, merges main, resolves conflicts, audits tests and JSDoc, runs the suites, rewrites the PR description as DX snippets, and asks the user
author: pingdotgg
